title: PortusSophia™ Notation and Representation Control
principle: A visible glyph is a representation of a locally stated relation. Its appearance alone does not determine the operative relation represented by that distinction.

mappings.statement: An operative non-equality relation may be rendered to a reader by the glyph ≠ without making the glyph the operator.
mappings.reverse_inference: The glyph ≠ does not uniquely recover !==.
